description: A `flow: tree` dynamic with `stop_on_error: true` and `max_concurrency: 1`: branch 'a' fails first (the limiter serializes dispatch to index order, so this is deterministic, not a race), which cancels the still-queued 'b'/'c' before either ever starts. The final state's 'fan' node has only 'a' -- a cancelled child leaves no node at all (electricity/docs/spec/runtime-semantics.md §5.5, DESIGN.md §6.5).
